//: The FAF training catalogue. Read by the FAF client's Training tab.
//editing: Accepting a submission from the client writes this file, so keep it valid JSON.
Every field of a resource is optional except id and title.
An id is a file name and the key `related` points at: lowercase, hyphens.
//links: replayReviewChannel is where a replay review request is pasted, as a
one straight to the channel and the client copies the request on the way out,
so the player lands in the right place with one paste left. Turn on Developer
Mode in Discord and use Copy Link on the channel. Empty falls back to discordUrl.
//trainers: The training team, shown as tiles in the client.
Only `name` is required. `accepting` defaults to true.
`fafId` is worth chasing: with it the tile opens the FAF player card,
resolves the real rating and avatar, and can be messaged from the client.
